item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 23/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The upper-air disturbances now affecting the region will depart in the following couple of days, rain will ease off gradually. Winds will be weak with improving weather over the coast of Guangdong early next week. It will be rather warm during the day. Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, temperatures will fall appreciably over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
